claims.source_quote_ar: حِطَّةٌ فعلة من الحط كالجلسة والركبة، وهي خبر مبتدأ محذوف، أى مسألتنا حطة، وأمرك حطة. والأصل: النصب بمعنى: حط عنا ذنوبنا حطة. وإنما رفعت لتعطى معنى الثبات
claims.claim_ar: رفع اسم الخبر «حِطَّةٌ» بدلًا من نصب الأصلي مقصود بلاغيًا ليعطي معنى الثبات والديمومة بدلاً من الفعل المؤقت.
claims.claim_en: The noun حِطَّةٌ is raised (nominative) instead of the expected accusative; rhetorically this nominative raising conveys permanence/stability rather than a temporary injunction.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Gives the supplication a sense of lasting effect/stationing (not a fleeting or momentary plea).

claims.source_quote_ar: أمروا بالسجود عند الانتهاء إلى الباب شكراً للَّه وتواضعاً.
claims.claim_ar: اختيار صيغة الحال المنصوبة «سُجَّدًا» بعد أمر الدخول يؤكد الكيفية والغاية (شكرًا وتواضعًا) ويعمل كنداء تأنيب/وصفي في الخطاب الإلهي.
claims.claim_en: The accusative manner-expression سُجَّدًا (sujjadan) after the command to enter emphasizes the manner/purpose (gratitude and humility). This functions rhetorically as an admonitory/descriptive specification of how to enter.
claims.needs_review_reason: Labeling as itnaab (a reproachful/admonitory tone) is interpretive; other analysts might classify this as specification of manner (fa'il/hal) rather than itnaab.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Specifies the required attitude (gratitude/humility) on entry, turning a physical act into a moral/ethical posture.

claims.claim_ar: توكيد التعريف في «هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ» يشير إلى معرفة وتعيين محدد للمكان (بيت المقدس)، أي تأثير بلاغي بتحديد المعنى وإثبات المخصوصية.
claims.claim_en: The definite demonstrative phrase هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ (this village/the city) with the following identification 'بيت المقدس' serves to define and single out the place; rhetorically it fixes specificity and recognition of the site.
claims.needs_review_reason: The claim rests on an exegetical identification in the chunk; other commentaries might emphasize different pragmatic effects (e.g., historical identification vs. rhetorical emphasis).
claims.rhetorical_effect: Anchors the command in a known, concrete place, increasing the immediacy and authority of the instruction.

warnings: Only Zamakhshari (al-Kashshaf) chunks were provided; requested sources (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) are not present. Claims are therefore drawn from the available Zamakhshari excerpts only.

Some device assignments (e.g., labeling سُجَّدًا as 'itnaab') are interpretive and flagged with medium confidence; different rhetorical taxonomies or other commentators may classify them differently. Review recommended for contested labels.
